sloka: धर्षयित्वा च काकुत्स्थौ न शक्यं जीवितुं त्वया।युद्ध्यस्व नरदेवेन लक्ष्मणेन रणे सह।हतस्त्वं देवताकार्यं करिष्यसि यमक्षये ।। ६.८७.३० ।।
transliteration: dharṣayitvā ca kākutsthau na śakyaṁ jīvituṁ tvayā।yuddhyasva naradevena lakṣmaṇena raṇe saha।hatastvaṁ devatākāryaṁ kariṣyasi yamakṣaye ।। 6.87.30 ।।

translations.english: "Clashing with Lakshmana of Kakuthsa clan is not possible for you. By waging war with Lakshmana, you will be killed and reaching the abode of the Lord of death. You will be doing tasks of deities of Devatas."
